purpose: Moye independent typography profiles, view-only mixed-script presentation and read-only paragraph optimisation; not Telari runtime differential acceptance

results.name: mixed-script view settings leave editable DOM intact and scope spacing away from code and formulas

details.proseFont: MoyeRole-Latin-7f1b97d3, MoyeRole-CJK-aa1bf226, "Noto Sans SC", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

capabilities.roleFontLimit: Named local fonts with unicode ranges, followed by the existing document font; unavailable fonts fall back. Generic families do not create a local font face.
capabilities.justification: Browser line justification; this is not Knuth–Plass paragraph optimisation.

limitations: Headless Linux checks do not cover real system IME, every font or native Windows/macOS.
Browser justification and native hanging-punctuation capability are separate from the bounded read-only box/glue/penalty optimiser.
